root_conclusion: Todas as29 annotations pertencem aos novos artefatos de auditoria. Nenhuma aponta produto ou a cópia do SDK. Renomear a cópia SDK trata o lint indicado por root, mas não os sinks dos probes nem os demais alertas Sonar.
security_interpretation: Execução dinâmica é intencional sobre fontes locais do baseline, com mocks; isso exige confiança e integridade do checkout. Não há evidência de novo endpoint vulnerável do produto, nem base para marcar todos os alertas como falsos positivos. O validator tem hardening real de argumentos/política de saída; o token é um fingerprint comprovado.

limitations: No Sonar state was changed and no issue was marked safe/false-positive externally.
No scanner rules, exclusions or baselines were modified.
No probe, product, CI workflow, network provider or live database action was executed.
The diagnosis is pinned to9a1c370c1979; any following publication needs its own observed check before claiming green.
The29 annotations are not29 independent vulnerabilities; related indices identify repeated sinks/downstream execution.
Underlying Sonar rule IDs, severity taxonomy and per-issue contribution to D/E ratings were not available; annotation_level is preserved verbatim.

independent_review.agreement: Confirmed fingerprint and Git identity uses; identified missing enforcement of definition_ref syntax; duplicate output-path alerts share one CLI write. Root separately authorized validator hardening; this report did not modify it.

annotations.sonar_title: Make sure that hashing data is safe here.
